payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Apply Apple Liquid Glass sparingly to navigation and controls. Use dynamic translucent material, lensing, and fluid transitions while keeping content clear. Respect reduced transparency and reduced motion settings.
payload.best_for: Apple-platform navigation, controls, and system-aligned app chrome
payload.css_technical_keywords: platform material, adaptive translucency, lensing, refraction, reduced transparency, reduced motion
payload.do_not_use_for: content layers, dense reading surfaces, or custom effects without accessibility fallbacks
payload.effects_and_animation: Lensing and refraction, adaptive translucency, and fluid morph transitions aligned to Apple platform behavior
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Use for navigation and controls, ☐ Keep content on a separate layer, ☐ Apply color judiciously, ☐ Test reduced transparency, ☐ Test reduced motion, ☐ Verify text and control contrast
payload.keywords: dynamic material, optical glass, translucency, lensing, refraction, fluid morphing, system navigation
payload.primary_colors: Adaptive translucent material derived from surrounding content; use color judiciously
payload.secondary_colors: Semantic content and system tint colors; preserve legibility and hierarchy
